current_state.target: Mendix anonymous surface, sitearchief search reflection, and uncovered top bodies (RWS/CJIB) + advieswijzer

recon_enumeration: toezichtdocumenten.igj.nl (Mendix): /xas/ = 401 (auth-gated, 0-byte body, no anonymous leak). /rest/, /odataservices/v1/, /link/, /mxclientsystem/, /rest/docs = 404 plain nginx. No published REST/OData service or open REST docs. Mendix client bundle self-reports version 18.2.0 (version info only; NCSC-ineligible, recorded not reported).

rijksoverheid.sitearchief.nl (Archiefweb PHP): the approved single marker POST to search.php (type=search&search=<marker>) returned 200 with the marker HTML-entity-encoded (<>) inside <strong><em>, 0 results. Properly escaped -> no reflected XSS. searchtoken is a result-nav token, not CSRF.

www.sitearchief.nl: root is an archived WordPress 5.8.1 snapshot (spacious theme); one representative archived asset returned 200 static image/jpeg. No first-party dynamic surface. archiefweb.eu and other sitearchief tenants recorded, NOT requested.

www.rijkswaterstaat.nl: ASP.NET Core MVC behind Microsoft-Azure-Application-Gateway/v2; search is GET /zoeken?keyword=. Special-char marker GET -> 403 (WAF 'Tijdelijk niet beschikbaar'). Follow-up benign alnum marker (zx9qbenign123) -> 200: the term reflects exactly once and ONLY inside the og:url meta content attribute (double-quoted attribute context). The breakout characters (" < >) are WAF-blocked, so reflected XSS is NOT exploitable. RWS = reasoned negative. robots disallows /zoeken*.

www.cjib.nl: Drupal (X-Drupal-Cache HIT, /core/, Drupal robots) = JenV Blueprint platform. /user/login = 403 (hardened to anon at edge), /search/node = 404 (core search not exposed). Strong CSP. No anonymous reflected surface.

advieswijzer.bigregister.nl (in-scope bigregister subdomain): Angular SPA (CIBG) with strict CSP (script-src 'self' 'strict-dynamic' nonce, object-src 'none', form-action 'self'), same-origin API. No GET-reflected search surface. robots empty (allow-all).

exploit_foothold.result: None. No write, no authentication attempt, no Mendix xas POST, no credential submission, no brute force, no WAF evasion, no record retrieval, no pivot. Only one approved benign search-marker POST (data-changing? no - a query).

failed_attempts_constraints: Mendix /xas/ and login are POST-only and hard-forbidden by the brief; the harness refuses any POST whose path contains /xas. Anonymous microflow reachability behind xas remains unassessable without an authorized POST wave.

www.rijkswaterstaat.nl /zoeken: special-char marker was WAF-blocked (403); a benign alnum baseline (not WAF-evasion) resolved it to negative - reflection is attribute-only in og:url and breakout metacharacters are edge-filtered. Encoded/evasive payloads would be WAF-evasion and were NOT attempted.
The 2nd approved POST was intentionally not spent: no additional brief-approved search endpoint existed (RWS search is GET; CJIB core search 404; advieswijzer is a same-origin-API SPA).
Oversized responses (RWS sitemap.xml, Mendix mxui.js) hit the 1 MiB cap; static binary bodies (sitearchief jpeg) were truncated locally, per the NCSC no-copy rule.
unexplored_surface: Mendix xas/ microflow behavior and any anonymous-callable actions (POST-gated; needs explicit authorization).
www.rijkswaterstaat.nl /zoeken behind WAF: only attribute-context reflection observed; POST/other params and WAF-bypass classes not explored (would need explicit authorization).
www.cjib.nl authenticated Drupal surface and Blueprint-platform APIs (login 403 to anon).
advieswijzer.bigregister.nl same-origin JSON API endpoints referenced in main-*.js (not enumerated; SPA data layer).
out_of_scope_recorded_not_requested: archiefweb.eu (third-party archive platform) — explicitly prohibited by brief.
Other *.sitearchief.nl tenants (tweedekamer, waarderingskamer, vrbzo, wkotool, etc.) linked from www.sitearchief.nl index.
www.toegankelijkheidsverklaring.nl (893 links from sitearchief index), cjib.bbvms.com, obi4wan/pusher CSP hosts, statistiek.rijksoverheid.nl (seen in CSP; not requested by this wave).
considerations_for_next_agent: No reportable vuln here; do not repeat these 18 requests. A future explicitly-POST-authorized wave is the only way to assess Mendix xas microflow reachability. For RWS /zoeken, the Azure App Gateway WAF masks reflection - decide whether a benign non-flagged probe is worth an approval. CJIB is Drupal with anon login blocked at edge; authenticated testing needs an account policy (currently undefined -> relay).

compliance.methods: GET only, except ONE supervisor-approved benign search-marker POST to rijksoverheid.sitearchief.nl/search.php
compliance.post_budget: 1 of 2 approved POSTs used; xas POST hard-refused in code and never sent
compliance.response_capture: body capped at 1048576 bytes; static binary body truncated locally
compliance.scope: Only the six brief-listed Rijksoverheid hosts were requested. archiefweb.eu and all other discovered hosts received zero requests.
compliance.prohibited_activity: No DoS, brute force, social engineering, malware, write/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, credential submission, auth bypass, WAF evasion, data copy, or out-of-scope request. The RWS benign alnum marker is a permitted harmless probe, not WAF-evasion (it bypasses no control).
